title: Kevin Pryor Joins LandonBuford.com as Staff Writer
htmlContent:
Kevin Pryor has joined LandonBuford.com and Buford Media as a Staff Writer, and LandonBuford.com and Buford Media are pleased to announce his new position. As a media professional and business consultant, Pryor brings the team a wealth of experience in broadcasting, consulting, and content creation. His most notable role is as the Co-Founder, Executive Producer, and Host of the 950 Lounge Show, as well as his leadership at 950 Media LLC. Kevin wears multiple hats. During the day, he is a business consultant, while at night, he maintains his highly regarded talk shows, 950 Lounge and DSN Sports Weekly. These are transmitted on multiple television networks throughout the United States, including iHeartRadio, Amazon TV, and Roku TV. He is passionate about media and can produce, host, and drive content that appeals to nationwide audiences.
"I’m truly excited to be joining LandonBuford.com," said Pryor. "It’s a tremendous opportunity for me to fulfill my passion for writing about sports. I’m happy to be partnering with Landon personally to bring quality journalism to the world. I can’t wait to get started."
In addition to his media ventures, Kevin co-founded 950 Media LLC, a platform where independent producers can host their content and turn their creations into profit. His entrepreneurial spirit has earned him the nickname #LebronJamesoftheRadioGame, making him a recognized figure in media circles. His path from a local internet show to a respected media brand ended with participating in the popular Netflix documentary Knock Down The House, which documented Congresswoman Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez's significant victory. Kevin grew up in the Bronx, New York, and is committed to contributing to his community. He is actively involved in local initiatives and utilizes his platform to inspire and support those around him.
Landon Buford, founder of LandonBuford.com, expressed his excitement about the partnership, stating, "We’re thrilled to welcome Kevin to our team. His expertise, passion, and dedication to producing high-quality content align perfectly with our vision at Buford Media. Kevin’s background in sports media and his ability to connect with audiences make him a valuable asset as we continue to expand our coverage. I’m looking forward to working together to bring fresh and insightful sports journalism to our readers."
With an extensive background and dedication to delivering impactful stories, Kevin Pryor can significantly impact, LandonBuford.com, bringing his expertise and passion for sports journalism to a new audience.
